problem: Which set is equivalent to $A={x\in R:|x-3|=4}?$
worked_solution:
The elements of the given set are the real numbers that satisfy the equation $|x-3|=4.$ So, we first need to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}|x-3| & =4 \\ x-3 & =\pm 4 \\ x & =3\pm 4 \\ x & =-1,7\end{aligned}
$$

The solutions are $x=-1$ and $x=7,$ and both of these solutions are real numbers.

Therefore, we can write the given set as

$$
A={-1,7}.
$$
